items.prompt: Why traverse from root after building children?

options.why: Parent labels need not be smaller; relying on that would leave some depths computed before their parent.
Query sorting does not fix the order in which tree depths are built.
A parent can have a larger label; traversing from the root still visits each parent before its children.
Depth is the number of tree edges from the root, not the numeric node label.

items.explanation: Numeric-order depth pass can read unset parent depth.
